> Due to the way the App Router and <InstantSearchNext> are implemented, you can’t compose hooks the same way as you would normally do in React InstantSearch. All React InstantSearch hooks have a skipSuspense option that you can set to true to skip the suspense behavior. This should be done to all hooks but the last one in your custom component.

Also, is this for each custom component? Or does it apply across components? I have many custom components that rely on hooks
